refnamediv.refpurpose: Interpret inherited resource controls and their units

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Resource controls can include fields inherited from a common resource type. A blank unit label does not mean dimensionless. Enter physical quantities in the units specified by the resource reference; the numeric editor does not convert a number with a unit suffix. Names, filenames, selectors and logical controls have no physical quantity to enter. This topic describes several inherited controls whose labels differ from the main reference tables.

Hardware origin components HWOriginInBCSX, HWOriginInBCSY and HWOriginInBCSZ are in metres in the spacecraft body frame. DirectionX/Y/Z and SecondDirectionX/Y/Z are dimensionless direction-vector components. These conventions also apply to radio hardware inheriting Imager geometry. The FieldOfView control names a field-of-view resource; angular quantities belong to that resource's own fields. See and .

entry.para: OrbitView and GroundTrack plot-history capacity, expressed as a positive integer count of stored plot points. This is distinct from a duration, the integration step or the redraw interval.
Estimator and Smoother output filename. This names an output file; it does not set the units of measurement data or the estimator state.
FiniteBurn algorithm selector. The supported value is MaxNumberOfThrusters. Enter the algorithm name; thrust, power and fuel quantities retain the units of their separate resource fields.
Subscriber output selector: All, Current or None. These are iteration-output modes, not an integer iteration limit.

MessageWindow decimal formatting count, a positive integer. Its fixed decimal stream uses this count for digits after the decimal point. Formatting does not change the physical units of reported values.

Spacecraft anomaly representation selector, such as TA, MA, EA or HA. It selects a representation rather than an anomaly value. Use the units and applicability restrictions of the selected orbit-state component in .

Spacecraft attitude display representation selector. Choosing Euler angles, quaternions, a direction cosine matrix or modified Rodrigues parameters changes the component fields and their units. See ; the selector itself is text.
Spacecraft reference to a SolarPowerSystem or NuclearPowerSystem resource. Enter the resource name. Power quantities and coefficients belong to that resource and retain their documented units.

Array's inherited parameter-owner reference. This is a resource name, not an array element. Array numeric values have user-assigned meaning and no automatic common physical-unit declaration. The Variable and String editors show an Initial value control instead of this inherited metadata field.
